same_game_note: NBA literature typically reports mildly negative margin|total correlation; this sample's estimate is noisy (n=138).

parlay_example.note: For POSITIVE correlation the joint win probability is ABOVE the independent product and the fair parlay odds are SHORTER. For two 0.58 legs the joint probability is bounded by [0.16, 0.58], so 0.58 is only reachable at rho=1. Corrected 2026-11-14 (FX-01): the earlier value of 0.58 came from an integration loop that ignored the first-leg threshold.

cross_team_same_day: same-team same-day parlays excluded by rule (only possible on double-headers)
